headline: Nigeria must reform federal revenue share or devolve powers, says Zrosk
summary: Nigeria must increase the federal government's share of national revenue or transfer more responsibilities to state governments. This adjustment is necessary to address persistent fiscal challenges according to Zrosk Investment Management.
why: Fiscal federalism structural changes dictate sovereign debt sustainability, sub-national credit profiles, and macroeconomic stability in Africa's largest oil-producing economy.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Reallocating revenue shares directly impacts federal versus state budget execution and overall fiscal deficits.
